summary: A highly skilled and accomplished Information Technology Manager with over 16 years of expertise in planning, implementing and streamlining IT systems to ensure maximum customer satisfaction and business revenue.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager / Network Engineer
responsibilities: Lead day‑to‑day operations for six offices and 300 staff members.
Manage a team of 6 IT professionals and developers for system upgrades and new software tools.
Align IT strategy with business objectives in collaboration with CIO and senior management.
Conduct capacity planning and negotiate hardware/software purchases to reduce costs.
Virtualized infrastructure with VMware, reducing physical servers from 50 to 4 and improving disaster recovery.
Migrated Active Directory from 2008 to 2012 R2 and Exchange from 2010 to 2016.
Implemented MPLS network across 8 sites, upgrading routers, switches, and network equipment.
Designed Citrix infrastructure with Netscaler load balancers to improve remote office connectivity.
Established disaster recovery site and business continuity plan.
Deployed Barracuda Spam & Virus Firewall, cutting spam by 40%.
Reduced desktop deployment times by 60% using System Center Configuration Manager.
Provided internal training on systems and procedures.

experience.title: Network Engineer
responsibilities: Administered Windows 2003 server network environment.
Managed LAN/WAN operations for local and remote networks.
Acted as technical consultant for clients and IT projects.
Provided end‑user support for Windows XP and 2000.
Installed and configured Exchange 2003 mail server.
Implemented server and desktop security with McAfee Enterprise and ePolicy Orchestrator.
Set up web, FTP, and POP3 servers.
Managed Cisco 1900 switches and 2600 routers; configured VPN remote access.
Applied software updates and domain policies via Group Policy and SUS.
Trained new employees in systems administration and web development.

experience.title: Network Support Technician
responsibilities: Provided network and desktop support to over 800 users across all offices.
Managed help desk using Help Star software.
Troubleshot Windows 98/2000 desktops and implemented Group Policy Objects.
Performed hardware/software upgrades and replacements.
Created disk images with Norton Ghost.
Maintained laser printers and copy machines.
